title: Headless That Lucky Old Sun (VMS03): Lt. Haggerty's referral (5), Fantastic's retargeting job (10), the reflector terminals, generator and mainframe, the tower console, and Fantastic thanked (quest completed)

actions.text: Path: at HELIOS One Lt. Haggerty hears why the player came (VMS03HaggertyInvestigate) and his offer to help with the solar tower (VMS03HaggertySolarTower, Science 30: 5); Fantastic, in the back, is talked round (SettleDown, Job, TryingToAccomplish, Retarget) and the player agrees to retarget the plant (VMS03FantasticIAmNow, begin script: 10, objectives 20/30/40, the west terminal's password); the west and east reflector terminals connect to the mainframe (VHeliosFarmTerminal1/2 item 0: objectives 20, 30); the auxiliary generator is mended (VHeliosAuxGeneratorSCRIPT, its box's button 1, shown with Repair 40 and a scrap of spare parts: objective 50); the mainframe terminal's power menu sends the power to the Strip and McCarran (VHeliosMainframeTerminalSub1 item 0: nPowerConfiguration 1, objective 60, 70 shown); the tower console (VHeliosArchimedesSCRIPT on ControlPanelHeliosTowerREF, 9:00-15:00) completes 70 and shows 80; Fantastic's DivertedPower line completes 80 and the quest (CompleteQuest; VMS03 has no Complete Quest stage, its only stages are 5, 10 and 255). Stand-ins: travel by move_player; Science 30 and Repair 40 given (set_av), one Spare Parts given (add_item); the hour set to 10:00 (GameHour) for the console; the plant's turrets and doors are not walked; the terminals' locks (password, hacking) are not modelled by the terminal op. Data note: Fantastic's IAmNow begin script adds the west terminal's password with no reference, so it goes to Fantastic, the speaker (a dialogue result runs on the speaker).
Stand-in for the walk out to the west reflector field.

actions.label: power to the strip and mccarran
